initialization_fault.observed: Original image crashed during actual RViz configuration loading, despite constructor-only plugin loading passing.
initialization_fault.cause: ToolManager calls initialize before emitting toolAdded. VisualizationFrame has no QAction entry yet; its refreshTool dereferences that missing action.
initialization_fault.fix: Connect to this Tool’s toolAdded event, then enable refresh in the next Qt event-loop turn. Earlier timer refreshes and activation are rejected by toolbar_ready_.

upstream_references.interface: ToolManager::addTool, initialize before toolAdded; refreshTool emits toolRefreshed.
VisualizationFrame::addTool creates the QAction; refreshTool dereferences tool_to_action_map_[tool].

shutdown_fault.observed: After the initialization fix, the window rendered for12s but SIGTERM invalidated the ROS context before the Qt timer stopped, producing RCLError and exit134.
shutdown_fault.fix: Stop the timer when its node context is invalid; catch the check/spin_some shutdown race; reject publication with an invalid context.
shutdown_fault.verified: The final actual RViz-only test survived12s and exited0 after SIGTERM.
